idea.label: Idea or open question
idea.description: Something to build or decide that is not settled yet.

decisions.label: Agreed decisions
decisions.description: Choices settled in an interview, recorded wherever the caller keeps them.

requirements.label: Requirements
requirements.description: Global and capability constraints, each with its source.

specification.label: Specification
specification.description: The canonical living agreement on behavior, design, and acceptance.

tasks.label: Task graph
tasks.path: local task files or the configured tracker
tasks.description: Verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria and blocking dependencies.

backlog.label: Backlog
backlog.description: Candidate outcomes and deferrals not yet in progress.

work-in-progress.label: Work in progress
work-in-progress.description: The approved current batch, unfinished acceptance, and evidence.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.description: Semantic records of authorized agreements and deliveries.

domain-records.label: Domain records
domain-records.description: Ubiquitous language, consequential decisions, and domain-agnostic code conventions.

research-note.label: Research note
research-note.description: A cited Markdown file answering a question from primary sources.

prototype-verdict.label: Prototype verdict
prototype-verdict.description: An isolated experiment and the evidence it produced for one design question.

decision-graph.label: Decision graph
decision-graph.description: A map of blocking questions toward a named destination, one decision per session.

questionnaire.label: Questionnaire
questionnaire.description: A Markdown document for the person who holds the missing answers.

code.label: Committed code
code.description: Changes committed on a branch, with their tests.

verification.label: Verification evidence
verification.description: The checks run and their actual results.

review-findings.label: Review findings
review-findings.description: Standards and Specifications findings with cited evidence.

merge-request-body.label: Merge request body
merge-request-body.description: Summary visual, before and after evidence, and merge danger.

feedback.label: Review feedback
feedback.description: Comments from a pull or merge request, issue, document, or pasted notes.

published-message.label: Published message
published-message.description: Approved text posted to a code host, tracker, chat, documentation, or email.

intake.label: Incoming requests
intake.description: Issues, tickets, bug reports, and external pull requests from other people.

ready-brief.label: Ready brief
ready-brief.description: The agent-ready execution contract triage writes for a verified request.

bug.label: Bug or regression
bug.description: Something broken, throwing, failing, or slow.

architecture-report.label: Architecture report
architecture-report.description: An HTML report of deepening candidates that passed the deletion test.

session.label: Session
session.description: The conversation and its log: what was tried, what failed, what was learned.

handoff.label: Handoff
handoff.description: A versioned brief a fresh agent reads to pick the work up.

memory.label: Saved lessons
memory.description: Reusable scripts, conventions, and preferences filed where the next agent looks.

environment-changes.label: Environment changes
environment-changes.description: Checks, guardrails, navigation pointers, steering files, tools, and access.

skill-issue.label: Skill issue
skill-issue.description: A retrospective on how the skills behaved, published on this repository.

workspace-config.label: Workspace configuration
workspace-config.description: Tracker, ticket conventions, triage roles, and domain layout.

tooling-config.label: AI tooling setup
tooling-config.description: Verified tool integrations, recovery methods, and a measured baseline.

tooling-report.label: Tooling report
tooling-report.description: Usage, output reduction, quality signals, and gaps from existing measurements.

git-guardrails.label: Git guardrails
git-guardrails.description: Confirmation prompts before git commands that can lose work.

delegation-policy.label: Delegation policy
delegation-policy.description: A machine-wide rule for routing work to the least expensive capable model.

agent-instructions.label: Agent instructions
agent-instructions.description: Documents an agent reads: skills, steering files, prompts.

polished-prose.label: Polished prose
polished-prose.description: The same writing without filler and AI tells.

technical-documents.label: Technical documents
technical-documents.description: README, API reference, runbook, architecture, or onboarding documents.

workflow-specification.label: Workflow specification
workflow-specification.description: A recurring loop specified so an implementer needs no questions.

process-recommendation.label: Process recommendation
process-recommendation.description: A mapped process, its delays, and a sequence to try next cycle.

visual.label: Visual explanation
visual.description: The smallest diagram, sketch, or HTML artifact that answers the question.

teaching-workspace.label: Teaching workspace
teaching-workspace.description: Mission, cited resources, HTML lessons, and a learning record in one directory.

wizard.label: Wizard script
wizard.description: An interactive bash script a human runs for steps only they can do.

labeled-items.label: Labeled items
labeled-items.description: Text sorted against your own labels before anyone reads it.

items.label: Unsorted items
items.description: Many pieces of text to triage, filter, bucket, or route.

worktree-branch.label: Worktree branch
worktree-branch.description: A task branch in an isolated worktree, leaving the original checkout untouched.

conflict.label: Merge conflict
conflict.description: An in-progress merge or rebase stopped on conflicting hunks.

recommendation.label: Next move
recommendation.description: The skill or sequence that fits, and where the human decisions sit.
